stage: Porsche directional shadows on native world receivers

limits: Finite motion and basic driving smoke test, not complete vehicle clearance or OEM physics
Zero-pose linkages are compared against the existing production rig; live wing actuators intentionally adjust their raw authoring rest frames
Source-fitted suspension, live screens and planar scene mirrors are implemented; Porsche tire-force tuning, optical appearance, instrument artwork and material refinements remain in development

receiver_gpu_fixtures.scope: Actual world shader receiver path, independent analytic ray-box expectations in each vehicle sampler, translated/yawed/tilted bodies, alpha masks, disabled maps, five sloped receiver/caster planes, and partial PCF overlap without doubled darkening
limits: Finite fixtures; terrain conformity, real vehicle footprint, scene visuals and rendering cost need separate checks

real_car_triangle_reference.scope: GPU world lookup at actual road/terrain/floor mesh intersections versus independent rays through posed car triangles at all nine PCF texel centres; closed, open/steered/tilted, and raised/rotated/suspension poses
limits: The filtered reference uses posed triangles and inverse light projection; it never reads GPU depth values and includes partial PCF edges
Masked-only ray hits are excluded from the opaque triangle oracle; alpha masks have separate GPU fixtures
This tests receiver conformity and car shadow projection, not vehicle collision clearance or world geometry casting onto the car

render_policy.maps: Reuse posed, car-relative R32F caster maps; no additional shadow-map draw for world receivers
render_policy.overlap: Minimum visibility, preserving partial PCF weights
render_policy.lighting: Direct world sun diffuse/specular/clearcoat, wet glint and foliage sun terms; environment, emission and local lamps retain prior contributions
render_policy.caster_depth_range: Occupied texels extrude along the light ray behind the far plane; clear texels and receivers before the near plane stay lit
render_policy.placeholder: Suppress Porsche oval when its directional map and shader bindings are available; retain existing fallback and other vehicle behavior
render_policy.state: Bind before world/mirror drawing, flush and clear after each pass; invalidate cached shader locations at shutdown

visual_observations: Car-shaped shadows follow the runway and adjacent ground rather than a flattened oval mesh
Opened doors extend the ground footprint
The deliberately raised fixture produces a displaced shadow on the surface below
The white/red finish and corrected steering shaft remain intact
remaining: World geometry casting onto the Porsche
Full-game frame time, memory/loading policy and LOD transition review
Porsche-specific handling, full mechanical clearance and requested final fidelity
